public_payload.normalized_proposition: Many AI boosters will act as if they were never wrong.

statement.excerpt: In the end, many boosters will simply act as if they were never wrong.

from_speaker: will simply act as if they were never wrong
our_interpretation: Read 'boosters' as public advocates of AI whose earlier factual claims can be identified.
Read the predicted behavior as denying or rewriting demonstrably incorrect earlier claims. Mere silence or continued optimism is insufficient.
'Many' means a substantial pattern across numerous advocates, not an isolated example. The speaker provides no numerical threshold or defined population.
'In the end' supplies no calendar deadline.
criteria.support_condition: A documented pattern among numerous identifiable AI advocates pairs demonstrably false earlier claims with later public denial or rewriting of those claims.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A defined, sufficiently broad population and completed observation period show that the predicted pattern did not occur. The source supplies neither boundary, so individual admissions cannot conclusively contradict it.
